To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose the first unsupervised learning approach for motion representation with transformation invariance, that we introduce the novel Trajectory20 dataset to evaluate motion representation learning approaches, and that we show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on the unsup-supervised skeleton-based action classification task.

We propose a novel capsule-based autoencoder for the unsupervised motion representation learning task.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed MCAE is able to learn a robust representation of motion that is invariant to transformations and that it outperforms the state of the art on various tasks in the field of unsupervised learning for skeleton-based action recognition.
MCAE is a novel and effective approach for unsupervised learning and representation of motion, and it can be successfully applied to skeleton-based action recognition.
MCAE achieves better results than the state-of-the-art on the unsupposed skeleton-based action recognition and the trajectory prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel unsupervised learning framework for skeleton based human action recognition.

the MCAE is the first model that can learn a motion representation from raw skeleton data without supervision, and that is invariant to viewpoint changes, while being more efficient than previous approaches.
MCAE can learn transformation invariant representations of motion in a purely unsupervised fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
transformation invariant capsule autoencoders are an efficient and effective tool for unsupervised learning from motion data.
the proposed capsule-based motion representation is a promising approach for unsupervised learning in the context of motion representation and human action recognition.
the proposed motion representation is a promising alternative to the widely used spatio-temporal convolutional neural networks for unsupervised learning.
